notes.publication_gate_per_schema_md: PASSED — judge_improvement (0.079) > 0.03 threshold AND 3-seed agreement in the positive direction.
notes.context: First first-party canonical positive result in the whitepaper v1.0 benchmark series. Produced by notebooks/customer_support_3seed_judge.ipynb at commit 37d8212 with all framework fixes from issue #16 applied (canonical RewardFunction signature, KL anchor enabled, safe defaults).
notes.headroom_explanation: The previous attempt with Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B as trainee (customer_support_3seed_judge_qwen35_08b.json) produced a stability finding — three seeds agreed at judge improvement -0.029 with σ=0.007, but the baseline judge score was already 0.90 (near ceiling). Swapping to Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct (baseline judge 0.75) created the headroom for training to surface positive transfer. This is direct evidence of the framework's behavior across the headroom spectrum: stable near baseline when no improvement is possible; positive improvement when improvement is possible.
supports_whitepaper_claims: §5.1 GRPO/GSPO objective — three-seed convergence to positive improvement validates the group-relative advantage formulation.

§10.5 KL anchor — the framework now has documented evidence across the full spectrum: no anchor -> gibberish (-0.39), anchor + ceiling base -> stable (-0.03), anchor + headroom base -> positive transfer (+0.08).
§B.1 hyperparameter defaults — use_reference_model=True, beta=0.05 with the otherwise-paper-default GSPOConfig produced the canonical positive result.
§7.5 benchmark methodology — the notebook is the reference implementation of the 3-seed + LLM-judge eval protocol.
notes.publication_status: Ready to cite in whitepaper §11.7 'First-Party Reproduction'.
